items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-12-20
items.q: That's the time Jimmy Palau was playing violin with him. ... He was playing violin with him.

ctx.x: Now he'd play out the lake and they'd say, look he was playing over here, the Infiddle Band. Was playing over there. Oh let's go. I mean everything was coming. I don't care who it was, they was coming along in there. That's the time Jimmy Palau was playing violin with him. Violin player. Yeah. He was playing violin with him. How was he on that violin?
